title: Kasy derbar Ma gai zahra
body:
Kesay darbar mai gayi Zahra
Kitnay naazon sy thee pali Zahra
Kesay darbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Jitnay darbar mai baithay thay saray hastay thay
Aur roti rahi teri Zahra
Kesay darbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye jesay Zainab ny shaamiyon sy thee rida maangi
Aesay haq mangti rahi Zahra
Kesay darbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye aik zalim ny jo tehreer ky haye tukray kiye
Haye tab khaak par giri Zahra
Kesay darbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray ronay ky liyen baat aik kafi hai
Haye bharay darbar mai gayi Zahra
Kesay darbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye tera darbar main jana na bhool payain gai
Haye thee qayamat ki wo ghari Zahra
Kesay darbar…
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye pasliyan tooti hoi theen aur hath bhi Haider
Zakhmi halat mai sogayi Zahra
Kesay darbar…
author: Syed Adeel Haider Kazmi
